thread:
sam: heads-up: deploybot auto-paused the canary cut. staging CI failing on artifact staging step (cache restore + multipart upload 503). Blocking release window. :grimacing:
meera: :eyes: seeing the same. deploybot shows `cache-restore-error` on job 42. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/42
kevin: logs look like transient S3 503 on multipart upload. can we retry or do we need to pin?
sam: deploy team asked for quick decision — if we can re-run safely in the next 10m, do that. otherwise pin to last-good and promote.
meera: quick repro from runner:
```
ERROR: failed to upload part: s3: UploadPart failed, status 503
I/O timeout while streaming archive
cache restore attempt 3/3
```
jen: we've seen intermittent 503s during high traffic windows. retry often fixes it but might hold the change window. ops-oncall any visibility on S3 errors in eu-west-1?
ops-oncall: seeing elevated 5xx from mirror proxy around 12:11 UTC, consistent with a partial outage. engineers are on it but no ETA.
kevin: given that, rerun risky. proposal: pin to `staging-image@sha256:abc123def` (last-green) and manual promote, then re-run a separate pipeline to validate new image and follow up with rollback plan if it regresses.
sam: +1 to pin. we should also add a note in release notes and ticket the rerun. Who will pin and publish the note?
meera: I can do the pin and trigger manual promote. I'll also add a short note in the release doc: "pin due to artifact staging 503; follow-up re-run scheduled".
jen: when you pin, set deploybot override flag `--force-promote`? or do we use the normal manual promote flow?
meera: don't use force. follow manual promote via release UI so audit logs capture it. I'll tag the release with `manual-pin-cache-503`.
sam: sound plan. meera, go ahead. ops-oncall, keep us posted on mirror recovery. kevin, tee up a rerun job once proxy is green.
deploy-bot: deploy paused by pipeline failure. Manual promotion allowed for user: meera. Audit id: db-20260322-617890.
ops-oncall: proxy team reports partial recovery at 12:25 UTC; monitoring still noisy. recommend waiting 10m and then re-run validation pipeline in a non-blocking window.
kevin: I'll queue the rerun at 12:40 UTC and watch. If rerun passes, we can unpin and promote next stable. If it fails, we'll keep pinned and open rollback postmortem.
jen: update PRs dependent on this so we don't accidentally trigger another auto-cut.
meera: pin applied: `staging-image@sha256:abc123def` — promoted to canary manually. Release doc updated: https://docs.internal/release/2026-03-22-staging-pin
sam: thanks. I'll notify product and docs about the temporary pin. moving to monitor channel. :thumbsup:
kevin: monitoring rerun now queued. will post final status.
deploy-bot: manual promote completed by meera at 12:30 UTC. canary health checks running.
kevin: rerun finished: all checks green at 12:55 UTC. marking rerun success. recommending to unpin and proceed with original image if no regressions in next hour.
meera: noted — will leave pin for 1 hour as a safety window then unpin if no issues.
sam: decision summary: pinned to last-green image to avoid delaying change window; manual promote done; rerun validated; unpin scheduled in 1h if stable. Follow-up: ops to root-cause proxy 503s and capture in incident tracker.
jen: documented in #postmortems and release notes. closing thread unless something changes. :white_check_mark:
